items.title: India Women's Team Wins Asian Games 2026 Gold, Ending 44-Year Wait
items.summary: The Indian women's team ended a 44-year wait by winning the gold medal at the Asian Games 2026, while also qualifying for the 2028 LA Olympics. A reverse shot by Lalremsiami provided the lead against the title holder, which was defended under the leadership of Savita.

items.title: Sujeet Kalkal Wins Men's 65 kg Wrestling Gold at Asian Games 2026
items.summary: Indian wrestler Sujeet Kalkal won the gold medal in the men's 65 kg category at the Asian Games 2026. He defeated Japan's Olympic champion Kotaro Kiyooka in the semifinal and Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev in the final.

items.summary: The Petroleum and Natural Gas Regulatory Board aims to add 50 lakh new piped gas connections and convert 40 lakh unbilled connections into active users under the National PNG Drive 3.0. The initiative also seeks to register 50 lakh additional users by the end of fiscal year 2027.

items.summary: SpaceX's Falcon 9 rocket launched multiple Indian payloads as part of its Transporter-18 mission. The payloads included Dhruva Space's LEAP-2 hosting In-Orbit Demonstration missions and Satleo Labs' TAPAS-1.

items.summary: The Indian women's recurve archery team won a historic gold medal, while the men's and mixed combinations secured silver medals. India reached a total of seven medals in archery, comprising four gold, two silver, and one bronze.

items.summary: CSIR-CCMB has developed an India-specific tool to predict the severity of Sickle Cell Anaemia. The tool aims to overcome the limitations of international scoring systems that fail to reflect the clinical profile of Indian patients accurately.

items.summary: Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh stated that delays in the Tejas combat jet programme are hurting the Indian Air Force. He added that India is aiming to finalise the Multi-Role Fighter Aircraft (MRFA) deal within the current financial year.

items.summary: Union Power Secretary Pankaj Agarwal announced that the Centre is considering new hydropower projects, including the Sawalkot dam project in Jammu and Kashmir. The project is significant amid prior objections and consultation requests raised by Pakistan regarding its construction.

items.summary: The government informed a parliamentary panel that Russia has agreed to accept around 70,000 Indian skilled workers this year. Mr. Jaishankar chaired the meeting on India-Russia relations, where members were also briefed on India's diplomatic stance on the Ukraine conflict.

items.summary: A tigress was released in Buxa as part of a conservation initiative aimed at establishing a self-sustaining and breeding tiger population. A Press Information Bureau (PIB) statement confirmed that the objective is to create viable long-term conditions for tiger survival.
